name: BUS-BRA: Breast Ultrasound Dataset with BI-RADS Categories
description: BUS-BRA is an open-access breast ultrasound benchmark dataset compiled by researchers from the National Institute of Cancer (INCA) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and CINVESTAV in Mexico. Hosted on Zenodo, the dataset consists of 1,875 B-mode breast ultrasound images acquired from 1,064 female patients. Each image is paired with verified biopsy-proven histopathological diagnosis (benign vs. malignant), Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) assessment categories (2 to 5) determined by senior ultrasonographers, and manual pixel-level binary tumor segmentation masks. The dataset also provides pre-defined 5-fold and 10-fold cross-validation partitions for reproducible machine learning benchmarking.
